title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Schedule of Limits and Option Premiums
content:
Cardinal Rental Reimbursement is written in six options. Each option is named for its daily limit and its per-loss maximum, and each carries the limits and the six-month premium shown below.

## Limits and premium by option

| Option | Rank | Daily limit | Per-loss maximum | Maximum rental days per loss | Premium, six-month term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900 | 1 | $30.00 | $900.00 | 30 | $15.60 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 | 2 | $40.00 | $1200.00 | 30 | $19.80 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 | 3 | $50.00 | $1500.00 | 30 | $24.30 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800 | 4 | $60.00 | $1800.00 | 30 | $28.90 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250 | 5 | $75.00 | $2250.00 | 30 | $35.20 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 | 6 | $100.00 | $3000.00 | 30 | $46.80 |

## Terms that are the same on every option

| Term | Every option |
|---|---|
| Twelve-month term multiplier applied to the six-month premium | 2 |
| Taxes, airport concession fees and facility fees count inside the daily limit | Yes |
| How a rental day is counted | Each 24-hour rental period |
| Unit to which the per-loss limits apply | Per vehicle, per loss |
| Rental cars that may run at the same time on one loss | 1 |

## Definitions

- **Daily limit.** The most paid for one rental day, taxes and concession fees included, in US dollars.
- **Per-loss maximum.** The most paid for all rental and transportation costs of one loss, in US dollars.
- **Maximum rental days per loss.** The most rental days paid for one loss, a whole number.
- **Premium, six-month term.** The full-term premium of the option for one vehicle on a six-month term. For a twelve-month term the full-term premium is the six-month premium multiplied by the twelve-month multiplier of 2.

## Twelve-month premium, derived from the schedule

The figures below are not separate rates; each is the six-month premium in the first table multiplied by 2.

| Option | Six-month premium | Twelve-month premium |
|---|---|---|
| 30/900 | $15.60 | $31.20 |
| 40/1200 | $19.80 | $39.60 |
| 50/1500 | $24.30 | $48.60 |
| 60/1800 | $28.90 | $57.80 |
| 75/2250 | $35.20 | $70.40 |
| 100/3000 | $46.80 | $93.60 |

## Reading the schedule

- *A rental agency charges $41.75 a day for the car, of which $6.10 is tax and an airport concession fee, on Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 (hypothetical figures).* The tax and the fee sit inside the daily limit, so the whole $41.75 is measured against the $40.00 daily limit.
- *Does a car held for 36 hours count as one day?* No. A rental day is a 24-hour rental period, so 36 hours runs into a second period.
